bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
local_tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
old_tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-reentry-89a6e
new_tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-media-caption-d404bc
rollback=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-link-media-20261120
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
oldid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$old_tag")" || exit 62
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 63
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$oldid" || exit 64
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$local_tag")" = "$oldid" || exit 65
docker logs --tail 240 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' || exit 77
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/link-reentry-candidate.XXXXXXXX)"
swapped=0
applied=0
cleanup(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if test "$swapped" = 1 && test "$applied" != 1; then
  docker tag "$rollback" "$local_tag" || true
  docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 fi
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
mkdir -p "$tmp/base" "$tmp/new" "$tmp/overlay"
gh run download 44767482471 -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$tmp/base" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 66
gh run download 44777691397 -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$tmp/new" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 67
docker cp deploy-gaybbs-1:/app/gaybbs.mjs "$tmp/live.mjs"
cmp -s "$tmp/base/gaybbs.mjs" "$tmp/live.mjs" || exit 68
docker run --rm --network none -v "$tmp/new:/bundle:ro" --entrypoint node "$old_tag" --check /bundle/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null || exit 69
cp "$tmp/new/gaybbs.mjs" "$tmp/overlay/gaybbs.mjs"
cat >"$tmp/overlay/Dockerfile" <<'EOF'
FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
COPY --chown=1000:1000 gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs
EOF
docker build --pull=false --network none -t "$new_tag" -f "$tmp/overlay/Dockerfile" "$tmp/overlay" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 70
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$new_tag")"
test "$newid" != "$oldid" || exit 71
if docker image inspect "$rollback" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$rollback")" = "$oldid" || exit 72
else docker tag "$oldid" "$rollback"; fi
docker tag "$new_tag" "$local_tag"
swapped=1
docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 73
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$newid" || exit 74
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 14); do
 if docker logs --tail 240 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY'; then ready=1; break; fi
 sleep 5
done
test "$ready" = 1 || exit 75
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 76
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='link_button_posts' AND column_name='media_caption';" | grep -qx 1 || exit 78
applied=1
echo LINK_REPEAT_CREATION_IMAGE=PASS
echo GAYBBS_RUNTIME_READY=PASS
echo USERBOT_PRESERVED=PASS
echo ROLLBACK_IMAGE_RETAINED=PASS
